description:
Try a free version of Ahrefs by going to: ahrefs.com/awt

Warning: this episode has talk of sexual abuse involving women and children. Viewer discretion advised. 

If you’re amongst the more level-headed of us human meatsacks out there, you probably aren’t on X. Unfortunately, a lot of the world is. Which makes it all the more disturbing that X (formerly Twitter) became a tool for turning photos into AI-generated doom porn at the start of the year. What? Huh? How did this happen? Let’s take a looksie.
